BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to life insurance policies; adding a new section tochapter 48.23 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 48.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.23 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A life insurer may issue and deliver an individual life insurancepolicy where the minimum death benefit under the policy does not equalor exceed the cumulative premiums for the policy if the amount of theminimum death benefit equals or exceeds five thousand dollars.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A life insurer may issue and deliver coverage under a group lifeinsurance policy where the minimum death benefit provided under thepolicy or certificate does not equal or exceed the cumulative premiumsfor the policy if the amount of the minimum death benefit equals orexceeds five thousand dollars. The group life policy may be offeredand sold whether or not the insured will pay all or substantially all p. 1 HB 2082of the premiums for the coverage if the policy is converted fromcoverage under the group policy to an individual policy.
